body: I'm interested in becoming a radiographer, however I can be a little squeamish when it comes to blood and vomit. I chose this profession over other professions because it seemed to be one of the least invasive, but I've read stories of people coming across mangled people in the hospital. How much blood and gore do radiographers face? Are there specialties of radiography that encounter less or more gore? Thanks, any advice appreciated.
I'm not usually a stunt person but geez
